title: China-to-Denmark Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EMC — IEC 62920 and IEC 61000 Evidence for Denmark PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: Denmark PV inverter EMC expectations should be prepared on an IEC/EN basis because DS (Danish Standards, ds.dk) adopts EN standards, and project specifications for grid-connected PV commonly reference IEC-family inverter evidence. The practical EMC package should include IEC 62920 for PV power conversion equipment and applicable IEC 61000-series evidence for emissions, immunity, harmonics, surge, voltage dips, and power quality. For Energinet grid-connected projects, harmonic and conducted-emission evidence should be tied to the actual inverter model, rating, and configuration. Because Denmark uses a 230/400 V, 50 Hz grid, EMC and harmonic results obtained only under China 220/380 V conditions should be reviewed for applicability before submission. CE marking under EMC Directive 2014/30/EU is mandatory for PV inverters placed on the EU/Denmark market.
target_standards: IEC 62920 — Photovoltaic power generating systems — EMC requirements and test methods for power conversion equipment
IEC 61000 series — Electromagnetic compatibility test, immunity, harmonic, surge, voltage-dip, and power-quality standards as applicable to the inverter configuration
EMC Directive 2014/30/EU — mandatory for EU/Denmark market access
DS (Danish Standards) standards adoption and project specification requirements where applicable
Energinet grid-connection review requirements for power quality and harmonic performance
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter EMC evidence commonly relies on GB/T 37408-2021 and related domestic EMC test reports from CNAS-accredited laboratories. These reports can be useful engineering background but are not automatically equivalent to IEC 62920 or the IEC 61000-series evidence requested by a Denmark project owner, DS conformity route, Forsyningstilsynet review, or Energinet grid-connection process. China test conditions are normally aligned with the China 220/380 V, 50 Hz baseline, while Denmark uses 230/400 V at the same frequency.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CNAS-accredited domestic EMC test reports under China standard scopes
rows.gap: Gap: China-only EMC certificates under GB/T 37408 do not automatically satisfy Denmark IEC/EN-based project expectations. Exporters should obtain IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the specific model or family, confirm whether harmonics and conducted-emission results remain valid at 230/400 V, and provide CE marking evidence under EMC Directive 2014/30/EU. EMC Directive compliance requires a technical file, EU Declaration of Conformity, and CE marking — none of which are produced by the Chinese GB/T certification process. Where Energinet or the project owner specifies harmonic limits or power-quality measurements, test reports should be mapped clause-by-clause to that requirement.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — CE marking under EMC Directive 2014/30/EU required for EU/Denmark market access; IEC/EN EMC evidence mandatory for Energinet grid-connection review and project acceptance
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T 37408 EMC evidence is a China domestic voluntary or certification-programme baseline and is not an EU/Denmark EMC evidence substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat Denmark PV inverter EMC as an IEC/EN evidence package requiring CE marking under EMC Directive 2014/30/EU, not a China GB/T certificate transfer. Prepare IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the exact inverter model, review harmonic and EMC applicability at Denmark's 230/400 V 50 Hz grid voltage, and confirm any DS, Energinet, Forsyningstilsynet, or project-owner EMC requirements before shipment.

rows.requirement: Energinet Grid-Connection Review — IEC 62116, IEC 61727, and 230/400 V 50 Hz Settings — Denmark
rows.target_requirement: Grid-connected solar PV inverters in Denmark should be treated as project-level grid-connection equipment subject to Energinet (energinet.dk) technical connection requirements and Forsyningstilsynet (forsyningstilsynet.dk) energy-sector oversight. The practical IEC evidence package normally includes IEC 62116 anti-islanding and IEC 61727 utility-interface compliance, with firmware protection thresholds, reconnection delay, voltage windows, and frequency windows validated for Denmark's 230/400 V, 50 Hz low-voltage grid. Denmark uses the same 50 Hz frequency as China, but the nominal voltage differs: Denmark is 230 V single-phase and 400 V three-phase, while China is 220/380 V under GB/T 156. Denmark has Europe's highest wind penetration, so Energinet may require specific grid-stability capabilities (reactive power support, frequency response) from larger PV inverter installations. Danish-language commissioning documentation is commonly expected.
target_standards: IEC 62116 — Utility-interconnected photovoltaic inverters — Test procedure of islanding prevention measures
IEC 61727 — Photovoltaic systems — Characteristics of the utility interface
Energinet technical connection requirements for grid-connected PV (energinet.dk)
Forsyningstilsynet electricity-sector approval or oversight requirements where applicable

rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter grid-connection evidence commonly includes GB/T 19964-2024 for PV power station connection, NB/T 32004 for grid-connected inverter technical specifications, GB/T 37408 for PV grid-connected inverter requirements, and domestic anti-islanding test results. These documents are built around China grid conditions and domestic acceptance procedures. China's low-voltage baseline is 220/380 V at 50 Hz, not Denmark's 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Chinese grid certificates and factory firmware settings do not automatically transfer to Energinet acceptance or Forsyningstilsynet project review in Denmark.
china_standards: GB/T 19964-2024 — 光伏发电站接入电力系统技术规定 (Technical Requirements for Connecting Photovoltaic Power Station to Power System)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
rows.gap: Gap: China GB/T and NB/T grid-connection evidence is not a substitute for Denmark Energinet project acceptance. Exporters should prepare IEC 62116 anti-islanding evidence, IEC 61727 utility-interface evidence, a Denmark-specific settings file, and commissioning records for 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Do not describe Denmark voltage as matching China: only the 50 Hz frequency matches, while nominal voltage differs from China's 220/380 V. For Denmark's wind-heavy grid, Energinet may additionally require reactive power capability Q(U) curves and primary frequency response evidence for larger PV installations. Danish-language commissioning records and documentation may be expected for project acceptance.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice for grid-connected projects through Energinet technical connection review and applicable Forsyningstilsynet project approval or oversight; EU RfG 2016/631 directly applicable in Denmark
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese grid-connection evidence satisfies China domestic grid acceptance only and is not an Energinet or Forsyningstilsynet approval substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Chinese GB/T grid-connection documents do not automatically satisfy Denmark Energinet grid-connection review. Prepare IEC 62116 and IEC 61727 evidence, re-parameterise inverter firmware for Denmark's 230/400 V at 50 Hz grid, and consider reactive power and frequency response requirements reflecting Denmark's wind-heavy network. Verify current Energinet and Forsyningstilsynet project requirements directly before shipment or commissioning.

rows.requirement: IEC 62109-1 / IEC 62109-2 Safety Evidence and CE Marking for Denmark PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: For Denmark solar PV projects, inverter safety documentation should be prepared around IEC 62109-1 and IEC 62109-2 type-test evidence for the exact inverter model or family. DS (Danish Standards, ds.dk) is the national standards body, Forsyningstilsynet oversees the energy sector, Sikkerhedsstyrelsen (sik.dk) handles product safety market surveillance, and Energinet controls the practical grid-connection interface. CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU is mandatory for PV inverters placed on the EU/Denmark market. Project submissions should include accredited IEC safety reports, installation manuals, ratings, nameplate data, protection-device coordination, earthing instructions, and environmental limits. Danish-language installation and safety instructions are commonly required for equipment installed in Denmark.

rows.china_equivalent: China safety documentation for PV grid-connected inverters commonly uses GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, domestic CQC or CGC voluntary certification, and CNAS-accredited laboratory reports. These documents are useful for supplier qualification but are not automatically accepted as IEC 62109-1/-2 evidence for Denmark projects. Chinese safety reports may also be based on China-rated configurations, labels, manuals, surge protection, and 220/380 V assumptions, while Denmark project files must reflect 230/400 V, 50 Hz installation conditions and satisfy LVD 2014/35/EU CE marking requirements.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CQC / CGC voluntary certification programmes for China domestic PV inverter safety and performance
rows.gap: Gap: A China-only GB/T 37408 or NB/T 32004 safety file does not automatically satisfy Denmark LVD/IEC safety expectations. Exporters must: (1) provide IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test reports for the supplied model or model family; (2) issue an EU Declaration of Conformity under LVD 2014/35/EU and CE mark the product; (3) confirm that labels and manuals match the Denmark configuration including 230/400 V settings; (4) document protection coordination and earthing; and (5) provide Danish-language installation and safety instructions. Any changes to enclosure, terminals, firmware settings, surge protection, or nameplate ratings for Denmark can require updated safety documentation and a revised EU DoC.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU required for EU/Denmark market access; IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test evidence is the standard route to presumption of conformity; Danish-language instructions required for Denmark installations
mandatory_status.cn: China GB/T, NB/T, CQC, or CGC safety evidence applies to China domestic or voluntary certification contexts and is not automatically transferable to Denmark

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on China GB/T or NB/T inverter safety files alone for Denmark PV projects. CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU is mandatory. Prepare IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test evidence for the exact model, align labels and manuals to Denmark's 230/400 V 50 Hz configuration, issue an EU Declaration of Conformity, and provide Danish-language installation and safety instructions. Confirm current DS, Energinet, Forsyningstilsynet, Sikkerhedsstyrelsen, and project-owner safety requirements before shipment.
